items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember when Al Aarons come to the band.

ctx.x: Al Aarons, the other trumpet player? The trumpet player was you…
Yeah, you, Thad Jones, Al Aarons, and Sonny Cohn.

items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was a good trumpet section. They worked together good

ctx.x: And…what‘s that trumpet player that used to? Albert Aarons. Albert Aarons— double ‗a‘, Albert Aarons. Myself…
Joe Newman, Thad, Albert Aarons…Thad four.
